summary: CyanBridge 2.5.1 makes Gemini Live and photo questions much smarter: Gemini Live can now see a live video stream from your glasses and understands when you want to stop, photo questions can search the web, act on your phone or start Gemini Live, and on-device answers start speaking much sooner. It also unlocks media sync on HeyCyan glasses with updated firmware. Recommended installation: Google Play For most users, the recommended way to install and update CyanBridge is through Google Play: Download CyanBridge from Google Play Google Play provides the simplest update path, automatic updates, and Play Protect checks. Availability of version 2.5.1 may follow the configured Play rollout. The APKs attached below are for users who specifically need direct sideloading. The AAB is for Play Console and testing tracks and cannot be installed directly.
